description: jQuery plugin code extending the val() method for form elements, including hooks for option, select, radio, and checkbox elements, handling get/set operations and special cases.

methods.name: val
methods.description: Gets or sets the value of form elements, with support for hooks and different input types.

methods.name: valHooks.option.get
methods.description: Retrieves the value of an option element, with fallback to text content.

methods.name: valHooks.select.get
methods.description: Retrieves selected value(s) from a select element, supporting single and multiple select.

methods.name: valHooks.select.set
methods.description: Sets selected options in a select element based on provided value(s).

methods.name: valHooks.radio.set
methods.description: Sets the checked property for radio and checkbox inputs based on an array of values.

methods.name: valHooks.radio.get
methods.description: Retrieves the value of radio or checkbox inputs, defaulting to 'on' if no value attribute.
